entities.summary: Frigolet Abbey is a grand Premonstratensian monastery complex in Southern France. It is located in the territorial commune of Tarascon, in the region of the Montagnette, the parishes of which are served by the canons of the monastery. It was originally associated with the Order of Saint Benedict. Frigolet Abbey is a minor basilica in Tarascon, established in 801 CE. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
